title: feat(varrev): two of eight clause-toggles reverse; nu is the rounder
science: Full 2^3 census of nu's three clauses (seed-exit, both-weights-1, support-drop) on B_6(0): exactly two toggles reverse the diamond, (0,1,1) at (8,6) and (1,1,1)=nu at (10,8), and nu is the variance minimizer among reversers (0.005906 vs 0.010623). Isolates the support-drop clause as what stops the cheap return-to-axis shortcut ((1,1,0) gives t_axis=t_diag=8). Notable tension in its own table: (1,1,0) has the smallest variance overall (0.005490) but does NOT reverse, so roundest and reverser are different rules.
